actions.description: QMP unix socket of the guest (default: $VMSCREEN_QMP). The QEMU command line needs -qmp unix:SOCK,server=on,wait=off. QMP serves ONE client at a time: do not run two QMP clients at the same instant.
Timeout in seconds for every QMP connect/read.

A directory BOTH vmscreen and QEMU can read and write (QEMU writes screendump/pmemsave files there). Default: the system temp dir, which is only right when QEMU runs in the same container. When QEMU sees the directory under another path, also give --qemu-dump-dir.

The absolute path under which the QEMU process sees the directory that vmscreen sees as --dump-dir (default: $VMSCREEN_QEMU_DUMP_DIR; needs an explicit --dump-dir). Example: --dump-dir /srv/vm/state --qemu-dump-dir /state. Only the path sent to QEMU changes; vmscreen reads and removes the files under --dump-dir.
Output prefix; .png and .json are appended.
Decode attribute bit 7 as a bright background instead of blink. QMP cannot read the attribute-controller mode bit, so this is a declared assumption (recorded in the output), not a detection.
Do not pause the guest (pair may straddle a redraw).
On a graphical or UNVERIFIED screen write PNG + sidecar with the exact flag/reason instead of exit 4.
Accept a screen whose cells are all verified except cursor-shaped uncertain cells (listed in the sidecar).
Overwrite an existing PREFIX.png / PREFIX.json.

routes.description: Write OUT.png and OUT.json (exact-text sidecar) captured at the same instant, for OCR corpus building: the guest is paused (QMP stop) while both are read, then resumed; only the VGA text buffer counts as exact for a pair (exit 4 on a graphical screen unless --allow-inexact).
